fetchErrorSessionRejected.message: Kick isn't recognizing your session right now, even though you're logged in. This usually happens when signed in via Google, Apple, or another social account, due to an inconsistency on Kick's own servers — it's not a bug in this extension. releaseHistoryV0Label.message: v2.5.67 — Per-channel alerts, watch time and fixes

releaseHistoryV0Body.message:
• New channel alerts window (tune button on a channel card): get notified when a channel changes category or title, when a stream ends (with how long it lasted) and when someone raids it (who, and with how many viewers). Everything is off by default
• Per-channel filter: only notify when the category is one you chose or the title contains one of your words
• These alerts have their own quieter sound (Soft drop, Light chime, Tick), the Windows sound or silence, with a separate volume
• Watch time: History shows how long you watched in the last 7 days and your top channels (stored only on this device)
• Hover a channel preview image to see it large; card buttons always fit
• Fixed on current Chrome (148+): notifications played the Windows sound in "Extension sounds" mode and lost their Open / Mute buttons
• Cloud Sync no longer undoes an imported settings file, and a setting too large to sync is kept instead of overwritten
• Settings no longer cut off in longer languages; stronger fallback for skipping live ads

releaseHistoryV1Body.message:
• Redesigned popup: cleaner header, counters on the tabs (live channels, new notifications), calmer cards and one consistent switch style across all settings
• New "System" theme that follows your computer's light or dark mode
• Fonts and icons now ship inside the extension: icon names no longer show up as text on slow connections, and the popup makes no requests to Google
• History: repeated identical notifications are merged and empty categories are hidden
• Clearer sound-mode icons, visible keyboard focus, and your system's "reduce motion" setting is respected

releaseHistoryV2Body.message:
• Fixed the Chat tab's Kick username field silently failing to save if you typed it and closed the popup right away
• Fixed the same root issue elsewhere: favorite channels, per-channel sound mode, channel groups, the auto-open list, the chatroom/channel ID cache, bot scores, and notification history could all lose a change if two updates landed close together — all of these now go through a write queue so this can no longer happen
• Fixed a critical Cloud Sync bug: if Cloud Sync was on, your Chat tab settings could silently revert to an old/empty state hours later with zero interaction, because a routine background sync check kept re-applying a stale cloud copy. Chat settings now sync immediately on every change, and that background check no longer re-pulls from the cloud on its own
